title: AI interaction disclosure policy
rule: Any AI system whose audience includes students, parents, or the public must present a disclosure before the first interaction of a session.
default_disclosure_text: You are interacting with an automated assistant. It answers from approved district documents and can be wrong. For decisions about a specific student or employee, contact the responsible district staff member.
enforcement: A use case flagged public_facing cannot reach approval status APPROVED without a non-empty disclosure string.
